subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should OpenClaw preserve automatic bare-text source replies as the default while adding targeted inter-tool/final-only guards, or should source-channel delivery move toward explicit message-tool-only semantics by default?
rationale: Current docs and tests intentionally preserve automatic final text for compatibility, while the issue asks for stronger explicit-send semantics that would change existing channel behavior.

options.title: Preserve defaults with stronger guards
options.body: Keep automatic final replies compatible, but suppress unphased inter-tool/internal text and harden cron/message-tool delivery with focused tests.

options.title: Move defaults to explicit send
options.body: Make source-channel visible output message-tool-only or final-tag-only by default, accepting upgrade risk and migration/docs work.

options.title: Ship opt-in escape hatches only
options.body: Land configurable final-tag or verbose-off mitigations without changing the default leak-prone automatic paths.

recommendation.title: Preserve defaults with stronger guards
recommendation.body: Keep automatic final replies compatible, but suppress unphased inter-tool/internal text and harden cron/message-tool delivery with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent source-reply default and documentation history makes steipete the clearest owner for the compatibility/product choice.
